title: Isomorphism invariance of the girth of Artin groups
summary: For all Artin groups, we characterise the girth (i.e. the length of a shortest cycle) of the defining graph algebraically, showing that it is an isomorphism invariant. Using this result, we prove that the Artin groups based on a cycle graph are isomorphically rigid. Alongside the girth, we introduce a new graph invariant, the weighted girth, which takes into account the labels of the defining graph.
